description: Fixed IMU mounting rotation relative to EE/tool frame (R_imu = R_world_bias . R_ee . R_mount). Re-fitted 2026-10-18 from the ASSIST IMU campaign (329 still samples, gravity direction vs FK): gravity error 9.4 -> 2.8 deg RMS. base_tilt_deg = robot base tilt about x / y (rotation vector).
